boundedCandidates.criticalRisk: An async convenience helper or unconditional await on an else path creates a new microtask boundary and can change concurrent request/revision/credential-watch ordering. Do not wrap the entire617-byte block with a new await without proving scheduling equivalence.

notAdopted.name: Config field/default compaction
notAdopted.observed: 198 emitted __publicField statements,197 bare source declarations plus display=1; constructor subsequently makes198 explicit assignments.
notAdopted.referenceCoordinates: All198 individual statements and hashes are in GF-LOGIC-SPANS.json. This sum excludes whitespace between statements, helper overhead and constructor assignments.
notAdopted.whyNotEquivalent: declare removes runtime own-property creation and can expose inherited setters/non-writable properties. Moving constructor defaults into initializers changes evaluation order: declaration order differs from assignment order and10 right-hand sides invoke factories/normalizers. Preserve property insertion order, descriptor behavior, new arrays/objects, __proto__ protection and default evaluation before considering this transformation.

emitted.label: cloneConfigValue; containing function, not an entire duplicate
cloneValue; containing function, not an entire duplicate

notAdopted.whyNotEquivalent: model clone uses HasProperty on every array position and preserves inherited/nonenumerable indexed items and holes; credential clone iterates enumerable own keys, excludes array custom properties and optionally strips sensitive object keys. Both preserve cycles/sharing but enumeration and sanitization differ. A single undifferentiated clone weakens compatibility or secret filtering.

notAdopted.name: One equality helper for patch and JSON credential data

emitted.label: credentialsEqual; containing function, not an entire duplicate
configPatchValuesEqual; containing function, not an entire duplicate

notAdopted.whyNotEquivalent: patch equality uses Object.is, preserves NaN identity and distinguishes-0, own undefined keys and raw function/symbol values. Credential equality maps nonfinite numbers to null and function/symbol to undefined, removes undefined object values and maps absent/undefined array values to null. Similar traversal does not imply equal predicates. config/diff equality also has JSON semantics, but that module is absent from the currentGF graph so its consolidation is no demonstrated currentGF saving.

notAdopted.name: Merge complete scalar/batch broker pipelines
notAdopted.whyNotEquivalent: Single pending identity includes image SHA and optional slot protocol/detection text. Batch has batch mode/fingerprint, deduplicated item keys, partial cache reads, whole-neighbor recomputation for AI multi-segment, separate leaked/plain missing groups, validation of native batches and atomic cache publication. Common shared-deadline recovery already preserves each waiter cancellation. These complete functions are containing scopes, not redundant copies.
